system.description:
You attack with a sword in a way that has a greater risk of making an error but gains an additional benefit. Your GM intrusion range for this attack increases by 2 (from 1 on a d20 to 1–3 on a d20), but if you hit you can choose one of the following additional effects:

Eat Steel: The foe takes +2 damage.

Slice and Step: You reposition your foe or yourself an immediate distance away, easing your attack on your next turn (whether against that foe or a different one).

Action.
